Signature help shows default argument values from the AST.

-- flags --
-ignore_extra_diags

-- args.go --
package fork

func greet(name string, greeting string = "hello") string {
	return greeting + " " + name
}

func _() {
	greet("x") //@signature("(", "greet(name string, greeting string = \"hello\") string", -1)
}
